
 Usage: agentos expose [OPTIONS] {port}

 Open your dev server (localhost:PORT here) in one browser lane, so you can try
 your app with the lane's real, logged-in accounts: "Sign in with LinkedIn" and
 the redirect back, embeds, cookies.

 The lane opens it at https://NAME.expose.agentos.invalid, and agents driving
 the lane see it in browsers_list.

 Only that lane, only while this command runs: Ctrl-C, --for or a dropped SSH
 session ends it.

 No port opens anywhere and the lane's proxy never carries it. WebSockets (hot
 reload) do not pass: reload.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    port      <int>  The port your dev server listens on here, for example  │
│                       5173.                                                  │
│                       [required]                                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --lane        <str>  The browser lane that may open it, for example       │
│                         personal/linkedin.                                   │
│                         [required]                                           │
│    --node        <str>  Connection name (default: the node that has the      │
│                         lane).                                               │
│    --name        <str>  The address's name:                                  │
│                         https://NAME.expose.agentos.invalid (default: dev).  │
│    --for         <str>  How long at most: 30m, 2h, 1d (default 2h, at most   │
│                         12h).                                                │
│    --help               Show this message and exit.                          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
